critical_code_review_comments: OK · scalp/engine.py update_account_snapshot(account_id, snapshot) at L118 — for each runner returned by runners_for_account(account_id) merges the snapshot into r.account (dict spread) and syncs r.equity when snapshot['equity'] is not None. Idempotent, cheap, no async work. Called from bridge_routes.py at L273-277 AFTER accounts.update_one, wrapped in try/except so any propagation failure never breaks the HB path.

OK · scalp/engine.py Runner.status() broker_state at L1422-1436 — exposes heartbeat_at, heartbeat_age_sec, equity_age_sec (correctly reuses last_heartbeat since equity travels on the same HB), symbol_specs_updated_at + symbol_specs_age_sec (independent from HB — a stale specs field is now surfaced even if HB is fresh), spreads_age_sec, connection_status and last_order_ack_ms. commission_check dict is surfaced at L1437 alongside.

OK · scalp/engine.py _submit_live pre-submit refresh at L721+ + reject_stage='pre_submit_broker_state' at L800-810 (broker state stale OR equity moved >2% since decision) + submission_capacity guard at L813-820 (MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBMISSIONS=8, env-overridable). OK · scalp/engine.py reconcile_commission at L1352 — computes observed median USD-per-lot-side from filled_live decisions, populates self.commission_check {configured, observed_deals, observed_median, mismatch (True if >50% deviation and >=5 observations)} and emits CRITICAL log on mismatch. Called from restore_risk at L1346 so status() reflects it immediately after a runner restore.
OK · scalp/stats.py block_bootstrap_ci — verified brackets sample mean on 300-sample gaussian series (lo=2.623, mean=2.764, hi=3.072) and returns None below 20 samples (spec-compliant).

OK · protection_guard.broker_stop_constraints — ignores symbol specs older than SYMBOL_SPEC_MAX_AGE_SEC (86400s) and returns None so EA-side clamps remain the source of truth. Covered by unit tests.

OK · routes/bridge_routes.py L268-277 — accounts.update_one($set: set_doc) then update_account_snapshot(str(acc['_id']), set_doc) — snapshot dict is exactly what was persisted, so in-memory runners are byte-for-byte consistent with Mongo after this call.

OK · routes/scalp_routes.py metrics endpoint L75-179 — window {type:rolling, max_samples:5000, n, from_ts_ms, to_ts_ms, note}, lifetime aggregate via $group, alpha.net_expectancy_ci95_pips = block_bootstrap_ci(reversed(net)) (oldest→newest so recent lucky window can't inflate CI), model resolved by runner.model_key() when account_id is present (model_scope='OnEquity|demo|EURUSD' style) else 'symbol_only', commission_check mirrors runner.commission_check.

Non-blocking, just a note for the next iteration.

rca of the issue: N/A — Round 14 hardening implemented by main agent and independently verified here. One test-side transient observed and mitigated: the enabled_runner fixture on the very first cold call to /api/scalp/status can hit a hydration race where an enabled runner from scalp_configs has been created but its .account has not yet received an HB snapshot in the module-scoped fixture cache.
